# Payments Platform – Weekly Update (Nov 3–7, 2026)

## Progress
- Apple Pay rollout reached 100% of iOS users on Wednesday, with no incidents.
- Checkout success rate rose from 97.2% to 98.1% week over week, mostly due to the retry fix.
- Closed 14 bugs; 3 remain open from the Black Friday load test.

## Plans
- Start Google Pay beta at 5% of Android users.
- Begin moving the ledger to the new DB cluster.

## Problems
- PCI audit questionnaire is due Friday and will take ~2 days of engineering time.
- Card vendor sandbox was down Monday and Tuesday, which blocked integration tests.
- Sam was out sick Tuesday–Thursday, reducing capacity.

# Search Team – Weekly Update (Oct 27–31, 2026)

## Progress
- Shipped typo-tolerant matching to all users on Tuesday.
- Zero-result searches fell from 8.4% to 5.9%.
- p95 latency held at 180 ms despite the new matching.
- Interviewed 4 candidates for the open relevance engineer role; 1 offer is out.

## Plans
- Start an A/B test of the new ranking model on 10% of traffic on Monday.
- Build the synonyms admin page.

## Problems
- The click-log pipeline lost two days of data (Tue–Wed) after a schema change, so ranking evaluation for those days is unreliable. This could affect reading of the upcoming A/B test baseline.
- The team is still one engineer short, as it has been since September.

# Mobile Team – Weekly Update (Nov 10–14, 2026)

## Progress
- Released Android 6.2 (offline drafts); crash-free sessions rose from 99.1% to 99.6%.
- App Store rating is 4.6, up from 4.4 a month ago.

## Plans
- Ship iOS 6.2 once approved.
- Start the tablet layout spike (2 engineers).

## Problems
- iOS 6.2 has been stuck in app review since Wednesday; the reviewer asked about the new camera permission.
- The shared design system package bump to v3 broke 40+ snapshot tests, costing half a day.
